svg.title: Animated four-dimensional rotation and its three-dimensional shadow
svg.desc: A tesseract automatically rotates in four dimensions. Perspective projection removes the fourth coordinate to create an animated three-dimensional shadow, rendered on the screen with depth cues.
svg.text: You cannot see 4D—but you can watch its shadow change
A tesseract rotates through the x–w and y–z planes, then projects from ℝ⁴ into ℝ³.

svg.text: Mathematical model: vertices (±1, ±1, ±1, ±1), 32 edges, simultaneous plane rotations, then 4D perspective projection.
